titles.title: Untitled (Misti – A Memory)

description: The tall, triangular form of Misti volcano stands above a flat landscape. Gray clouds cut across the image, obscuring the center third of the mountain, which is light purple at its base and white at its peak. The landscape below is pale pink, while the sky above is pale blue in color.
title: Untitled (Misti – A Memory)
